payload.title: PyTorch → Triton cheat sheet
payload.summary: Single-file reference for the **first framework migration** (V0 is a PyTorch reference wrapper; the first optimization iteration lowers it to Triton). Read once. This is the one transition where the target DSL (Triton) is well-known, so this sheet is the map + the non-obvious gotchas; no external source pointers are needed.

sections.heading: Non-obvious gotchas
sections.gist: - **`nn.Linear` weight is `[out, in]` = `[N, K]`.** `tl.dot` needs `[BLOCK_M,BLOCK_K] × [BLOCK_K,BLOCK_N]`, so load the weight tile as `[offs_n, offs_k]` and **transpose** it before the dot.

sections.heading: Structure
sections.gist: `@triton.jit` kernel (grid over output tiles / rows) + a thin wrapper that computes the grid and launches.
